notes:
Quick notes from meetings and threads:
- Company: mid-market SaaS (helpdesk focused), productized chat agent for multilingual support.
- Primary ask: hosted API first to validate performance, then Dedicated if predictable latency/cost needed.
- POC scope: streaming (server->client) + tool calling (order status, account lookup via webhook) + safety filters.
- Latency SLA: target first-token <1.5s for US region (quoted repeatedly by PM: "first token must feel instant for chat"). Tail and p95 also important.
- Throughput estimate: ~200-400 concurrent active chats during peaks; expected 1M tokens/mo initial, growth to 3-5M. Cost sensitive but will pay for predictable performance.
- Model preferences: open to Llama2/Redwood-verified variants + possibility of smaller quantized models for routing cheaper requests. Interested in fast streaming SDK and function-calling compatibility.
- Routing: want automatic fallback to cheaper variant under load, but must preserve tool-calling behavior. Asked about model pinning & rollout controls.
- Security: SSO/SAML enterprise SSO mandatory for admin console, audit logs for tool calls, KMS integration for encryption at rest, 30-90 day retention policy configurable, EU data residency for some customers.
- Quotes from PM: "If streaming isn't rock solid, we can't ship this quarter." and "We need to see consistent <1.5s FT under our sample traffic."
- POC success criteria: <1.5s first-token median, no dropped streams, successful function calls in 99% of attempts, cost estimate within 20% of hosted projection.
- Next steps action items: engineering to supply sample chat traces + tool-call specs; Redwood to configure a hosted POC tenant, run synthetic replay and real-time integration test; finance to provide draft Dedicated baseline pricing.
- Risks: legal needs SOC2 / equivalent or acceptance of Redwood's attestations; potential extra engineering time for session-level tool auth integration.
- Administrative links: Drive deck and tech spec shared (see linked_drive_docs). Jira SEC-9910 opened for KMS/q audit questions.
- AE notes: keep demo focused on streaming startup latency, show function call reliability and fallback routing controls.
